verdict.rationale: Browserbase documents programmatic creation, control, and observation of browser sessions. It also documents a Downloads API, an official Node SDK reference, and API-key access advertised in llms.txt, so the product can be driven through a documented public API. Missing for 10: a published machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404), explicit REST endpoint reference content in the pack, and independent or hands-on corroboration of API use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
